work.title: Musik til Just Mathias Thieles Skuespil "Klaus Rigmands Skat"
Music for Just Mathias Thiele's Play "Klaus Rich Man's Treasure"

history.p: Thiele's play had been handed in to The Royal Theatre anonymously. It was based on a Danish folk tale. After seven performances it was taken off the bill.

titlePage.p: "Klaus Rigmands Skat" / Skuespil i fem Acter / Partitur. Stamped "DET / KONGELIGE / THEATERS / EIENDOM".

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in brown cardboard cover with handwritten label: "Klaus Rigmands Skat. / Partitur. / 471.". Stamped "DET / KONGELIGE / THEATERS / EIENDOM. Written in ink. Paper: 16 staves. Paginated 2-16. Last two pages unnumbered and blank. After the last bar on p. 16 "Fine / [Gade's musical signature] / 18 Martz / 1859.".

Bound in cardboard cover with marbled sides and cloth spine. In the middle of the front cover a handwritten label inscribed: "1. Wilhelm Tell. A 375 / 2. Iphigenia i Aulis A 478 / 2a. Klaus Rigmands Skat A 471. / 3. Montechi og Capuletti / A 395". Written in ink on two staves. Paper: 12 staves. Text between the staves.
